next.reason: 1985: "Identifier-1 and identifier-2 must each reference an index data item or an elementary item described as an integer."; 2023: "Identifier-2 shall reference a data item of class index. / If identifier-1 references a data item of class index, arithmetic-expression-1 shall not be". Identifier-1 is unchanged. The integer sending operand is now arithmetic-expression-1, and no candidate rule requires it to be an integer, so non-integer operands are no longer refused.
